items.title: Courtland Sutton: Four catches in Week 8 victory
items.text:
Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Makes key grabs in Week 8 win
items.text:
Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Surpassed by rookie in win over KC
items.text:
Dobbins carried the ball seven times for 13 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.title: Jonah Coleman: Makes strong case for top job
items.text:
Coleman carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 63 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.title: Blake Corum: Leads ground attack in win
items.text:
Corum rushed 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

items.title: Bo Nix: Engineers another fourth-quarter comeback
items.text:
Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City. He added four rushing yards on three carries and threw a two-point conversion to Jaylen Waddle.
